subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant's Name], Thank you for your recent application for the Marketing Coordinator position at ABC Company. We have received your application and are currently reviewing it. We will reach out to you directly if your qualifications align with our requirements for the role. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need further information. Thank you for your interest in joining our team. Best regards, Hiring Team
